# Unix Command Line Cheatsheet

## File handling

- `tar -xvf` can be used as a standard command to unpack `tar` file families. 
	- `-j` flag to decompress `.tar.bz2` or other bzip-ed files
	- `-z` flag to decompress `.tar.gz`, `tgz`, or other gzip-ed files


# Unix Tools

## Docker

Containerized Linux environment on MacOS or Windows. 

### Install

Install the [Desktop App](https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/), or via Homebrew

```sh
brew install --cask docker
```

### Alternative

**Orbstack**: Lightweight program that intercepts all commands going to Docker and performs them. Also available via Homebrew: `brew install --cask orbstack`
